text:
Maya: AuroraHealth is seeing intermittent 503s on their Dedicated pool since 08:10 UTC, p95 ~ 600ms but p99 tail spikes to ~3s, customer flagged as P1 and wants ETA.
Darin: Ack, I'm looking. Initial hypothesis: autoscaler not scaling quickly enough under this seq len distribution. @Priya can you check pool metrics?
Priya: On it, pulling metrics now. seeing increased queue depth on pool-dedicated-aurora, lots of short bursts. autoscale events show cooldowns.
Sam: Any immediate workaround? we can route a small % to hosted as fallback while we fix.
Maya: Customer prefers a canary fallback with throttled traffic, they have compliance ok with hosted for 10%.
Darin: Plan: 1) Enable 10% fallback routing to hosted for AuroraHealth via routing policy (2) bump autoscale aggressiveness for that pool for 20m (3) open a hotfix PR to limit request burst concurrency. Who owns step 3?
Priya: I'll own 2 and 3. I'll open PR now. pinging @Leo for a quick CR.
Leo: Standing by for PR. prefer a config toggle so we can revert quickly.
Priya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/7234 : brief change in autoscale policy + new env var DEDICATED_BURST_LIMIT. Here's the k8s patch snippet:
```
- name: ded_pool_autoscale
  cooldown: 180
+ name: ded_pool_autoscale
+ cooldown: 60
+ burst_limit: 12
```
Darin: Deploy window? canary to prod after quick canary in staging for 5m.
Priya: Requesting deploy approval. deploy-bot: can we run canary deploy for infra/7234 to prod-stable:aurora? tags: canary-10pct
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for infra/7234 -> prod-stable:aurora (10% traffic). Logs at https://deploys.redwood/7234
Maya: Customer notified of temporary 10% fallback and we started canary. they're ok with 10% for now. :thumbsup:
Leo: Quick CR comments left, small nit on env var naming. will approve after tweak.
Priya: Updated PR, bumping burst_limit to 14 and renamed var to DEDICATED_MAX_CONCURRENCY. PTAL.
Leo: Approved. merging.
deploy-bot: Merge complete, rolling out canary to 10% -> monitoring p99 and 503 rate.
Sam: Monitoring dashboards - early signs: 503 rate dropped 60% for affected window, p99 tail reduced to ~1.2s for canary traffic.
Darin: Good. Keep the autoscaler tweak on for 30m, then revert to standard cool-down and observe for 1h before closing.
Maya: Customer updated and asked for weekly postmortem once stable. I'll own communication.
Priya: Leaving a short rollback runbook in the PR description. If 503s rise >30% revert routing flag: `./admin route set aurora fallback 0%` and revert autoscale config.
Darin: Thanks all. I'll follow up on infra postmortem and action items. Marking this thread resolved once metrics stable for 1h.
Maya: Thanks team :heart:
